Body.Content:
With Work IQ, Copilot can now retain useful context from how you work in a workspace so future responses are more relevant, consistent, and personalized. Copilot can use saved memory such as workspace details, working preferences, and recurring instructions to reduce repeated setup and help you continue work more efficiently across workspace sessions.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: November CY2026
